description: West and East African savanna — baobab and acacia parkland, tall grass, riverine wetlands. Feast in the rains, hunger in the long dry. The big animals drink here too.
name: Sahel Savanna

dry.note: The long dry. Grass cures to gold, waterholes shrink, herds walk to water.

dry_cool.note: Harvest, then the dusty harmattan wind. Cool nights, grain in the granary.

wet.note: The rains. Planting, mud, mosquitoes — and everything green at once.
